description: Retrieves a list of version control repositories for a specific Sentry organization, which must exist and is identified by its ID or slug.

organization_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID or slug) of the Sentry organization for which to list repositories. The slug is the URL-friendly name of the organization.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

name: list_organization_repositories

repositories.description: List of repositories connected to the organization
repositories.title: Repositories

Repository.description: A version control repository connected to Sentry

dateCreated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the repository was added to Sentry
dateCreated.title: Date Created

externalId.description: The external ID for the repository in the provider's system (may be null)
externalId.title: External Id

externalSlug.description: The external slug identifier for the repository (may be null)
externalSlug.title: External Slug

id.description: The unique identifier for this repository
id.title: Id

integrationId.description: The ID of the integration associated with this repository (may be null)
integrationId.title: Integration Id

provider.description: The version control provider for this repository
provider.title: Provider

url.description: The URL of the repository (may be null)
url.title: Url

Repository.title: Repository

name.description: The human-readable name of the provider
name.title: Name
